<title>Noir-Blanc Numismatique</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;1,300;1,400&family=Jost:wght@300;400&display=swap">
<style>
:root {
  --bg:     #f8f5f0;
  --bg2:    #eee9e0;
  --fg:     #1a1612;
  --fg2:    #6b5f4e;
  --accent: #8b6914;
  --gold:   #c9a84c;
  --line:   #d8cdb8;
  color-scheme: light;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {
    --bg:#0c0b09;--bg2:#131109;--fg:#ede8df;--fg2:#9a8c78;
    --accent:#c9a84c;--gold:#c9a84c;--line:#2a2520;color-scheme:dark;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg:#0c0b09;--bg2:#131109;--fg:#ede8df;--fg2:#9a8c78;
  --accent:#c9a84c;--gold:#c9a84c;--line:#2a2520;color-scheme:dark;
}

*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
body{
  background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);
  font-family:'Jost',system-ui,sans-serif;
  font-weight:300;line-height:1.7;overflow-x:hidden;
}

/* ── Top bar ── */
.topbar{
  background:var(--fg);color:var(--bg);
  text-align:center;padding:.55rem 1rem;
  font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;
}

/* ── HERO — split ── */
.hero{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  min-height:100svh;overflow:hidden;
}
@media(max-width:720px){
  .hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-template-rows:auto auto;min-height:auto;}
}

/* Left text */
.hero-text{
  padding:5rem 3.5rem 4rem 5vw;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:1.8rem;
}
@media(max-width:720px){.hero-text{padding:3rem 1.5rem 2rem;}}

.brand-name{
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  font-size:clamp(1.9rem,4.5vw,3.2rem);
  font-weight:300;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;
  line-height:1.1;color:var(--fg);
}
.brand-sub{
  font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.32em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--accent);margin-top:.3rem;display:block;
}
.gold-rule{width:44px;height:1px;background:var(--gold);}

.tagline{
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  font-size:clamp(1rem,2vw,1.35rem);font-weight:300;font-style:italic;
  color:var(--fg2);line-height:1.55;
}

.desc p{
  font-size:.9rem;color:var(--fg2);line-height:1.9;max-width:46ch;
}
.desc p+p{margin-top:.9rem;}
.desc strong{color:var(--fg);font-weight:400;}

.services{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.5rem;}
.svc{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;
  font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fg2);
}
.svc::before{content:'';width:18px;height:1px;background:var(--gold);flex-shrink:0;}

.email-block{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.35rem;}
.email-label{font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fg2);}
.email-link{
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  font-size:clamp(1.05rem,2.2vw,1.65rem);font-weight:400;
  letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--accent);cursor:pointer;
  border-bottom:1px solid transparent;
  transition:border-color .25s,color .25s;
  width:fit-content;padding-bottom:2px;user-select:all;
}
.email-link:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--accent);}
.copy-tip{font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--line);transition:color .3s;}
.copy-tip.ok{color:var(--accent);}

/* Right hero image panel */
.hero-image{
  position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  background:#1a0a06;
  overflow:hidden;min-height:100svh;
}
@media(max-width:720px){.hero-image{min-height:60vw;}}

/* Deep dark-red vignette behind coin */
.hero-image::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,
    rgba(80,20,0,.0) 30%,
    rgba(10,2,0,.85) 100%);
  z-index:1;
}
.hero-image img.main-coin{
  position:relative;z-index:0;
  width:100%;height:100%;
  object-fit:cover;
  opacity:.92;
  filter:brightness(1.05) contrast(1.05) saturate(1.1);
}

/* Coin glow ring overlay */
.coin-glow-overlay{
  position:absolute;z-index:2;
  width:min(55%,300px);height:min(55%,300px);
  border-radius:50%;
  box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(201,168,76,.35), 0 0 120px rgba(201,168,76,.12);
  pointer-events:none;
  animation:glow-breathe 4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes glow-breathe{
  0%,100%{opacity:.6;transform:scale(1);}
  50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.06);}
}

/* ── Gallery section ── */
.gallery-section{
  padding:4.5rem 4vw 5rem;
  background:var(--bg);
}
.section-header{
  text-align:center;
  margin-bottom:3rem;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.8rem;
}
.section-header h2{
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  font-size:clamp(1.4rem,3vw,2.1rem);font-weight:300;
  letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fg);
}
.section-header p{
  font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--fg2);font-style:italic;
}
.section-rule{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem;width:100%;max-width:300px;
}
.section-rule::before,.section-rule::after{
  content:'';flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--line);
}
.section-rule-dot{
  width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);flex-shrink:0;
}

/* Grid */
.gallery-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
  gap:1.5rem;
  max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;
}
@media(max-width:800px){.gallery-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}}
@media(max-width:500px){.gallery-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

.gallery-card{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  background:var(--bg2);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  cursor:pointer;
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);
  transition:opacity .8s ease,transform .8s ease,box-shadow .35s,border-color .35s;
}
.gallery-card.visible{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}
.gallery-card:hover{
  box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.14),0 0 0 1px var(--gold);
  border-color:var(--gold);
  z-index:2;
}
.gallery-card:nth-child(1){transition-delay:0s;}
.gallery-card:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.12s;}
.gallery-card:nth-child(3){transition-delay:.24s;}

.card-img-wrap{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  aspect-ratio:4/3;
}
.card-img-wrap img{
  width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;
  transition:transform 5s ease;
}
.gallery-card:hover .card-img-wrap img{transform:scale(1.06);}

/* Shimmer */
.card-img-wrap::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(110deg,transparent 38%,rgba(201,168,76,.1) 50%,transparent 62%);
  background-size:200% 100%;background-position:-100% 0;
  transition:background-position .55s ease;pointer-events:none;
}
.gallery-card:hover .card-img-wrap::after{background-position:200% 0;}

.card-caption{
  padding:.9rem 1.1rem 1rem;
  border-top:1px solid var(--line);
  position:relative;
}
.card-caption::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:1.1rem;right:1.1rem;
  height:1px;
  background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--gold),transparent);
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s;
}
.gallery-card:hover .card-caption::before{opacity:1;}
.card-caption h3{
  font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--accent);font-weight:400;margin-bottom:.3rem;
  font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;
}
.card-caption p{
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  font-size:.98rem;font-style:italic;color:var(--fg2);line-height:1.45;
}

/* ── Divider quote ── */
.quote-divider{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.5rem;
  padding:2.8rem 5vw;
  border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  background:var(--bg2);
}
.quote-line{flex:1;max-width:100px;height:1px;background:var(--line);}
.quote-text{
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  font-size:clamp(.9rem,1.8vw,1.1rem);font-style:italic;
  color:var(--fg2);flex:1;text-align:center;
}

/* ── Footer ── */
footer{
  text-align:center;padding:1.8rem 1rem 2.2rem;
  font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--fg2);opacity:.6;
}

/* ── Lightbox ── */
#lightbox{
  display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.93);
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;
  cursor:pointer;
}
#lightbox.open{display:flex;animation:lb-in .3s ease;}
@keyframes lb-in{from{opacity:0;}to{opacity:1;}}
#lb-img{
  max-width:min(88vw,860px);max-height:80vh;object-fit:contain;
  box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,.8),0 0 0 1px rgba(201,168,76,.2);
  animation:lb-zoom .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);cursor:default;
}
@keyframes lb-zoom{from{transform:scale(.85);opacity:0;}to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1;}}
#lb-cap{margin-top:.9rem;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);font-style:italic;}
#lb-close{
  position:fixed;top:1.2rem;right:1.5rem;
  font-size:1.6rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);
  background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;line-height:1;
}
#lb-close:hover{color:var(--gold);}
</style>

<div class="topbar">Estimation gratuite &nbsp;·&nbsp; Achat &amp; Vente &nbsp;·&nbsp; Discrétion assurée</div>

<section class="hero">
  <div class="hero-text">
    <div>
      <div class="brand-name">Noir-Blanc<br>Numismatique</div>
      <span class="brand-sub">Expertise &middot; Collection &middot; Commerce</span>
    </div>
    <div class="gold-rule"></div>
    <p class="tagline">Spécialiste en monnaies d'or &amp; d'argent,<br>médailles militaires et objets anciens.</p>
    <div class="desc">
      <p><strong>Achat et vente</strong> de monnaies d'or et d'argent, pièces de collection, ordres militaires et objets de prestige. Chaque pièce évaluée avec soin, au juste prix du marché.</p>
      <p><em>Buying and selling</em> gold &amp; silver coins, collector pieces, military orders and antique objects. Every item carefully assessed at fair market value.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="services">
      <div class="svc">Monnaies or &amp; argent &nbsp;/&nbsp; Gold &amp; silver coins</div>
      <div class="svc">Ordres militaires &nbsp;/&nbsp; Military orders</div>
      <div class="svc">Plaques émaillées &nbsp;/&nbsp; Enamel signs</div>
      <div class="svc">Estimation gratuite &nbsp;/&nbsp; Free valuation</div>
    </div>
    <div class="email-block">
      <span class="email-label">Contact</span>
      <span class="email-link" id="email" title="Cliquer pour copier">numismatique@noir-blanc.fr</span>
      <span class="copy-tip" id="tip">Cliquer pour copier l'adresse</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="hero-image">
    <img class="main-coin" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="20 Francs or — République Française">
    <div class="coin-glow-overlay"></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="gallery-section">
  <div class="section-header">
    <h2>Notre Collection</h2>
    <div class="section-rule"><div class="section-rule-dot"></div></div>
    <p>Pièces &amp; objets disponibles à la vente &nbsp;·&nbsp; Items available for sale</p>
  </div>

  <div class="gallery-grid">

    <div class="gallery-card" data-src="data:image/jpeg;base64," data-title="Napoléon III — 100 Francs Or">
      <div class="card-img-wrap">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Napoléon III 100 Francs Or" loading="lazy">
      </div>
      <div class="card-caption">
        <h3>Monnaies d'Or</h3>
        <p>Napoléon III — 100 Francs, Barre</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="gallery-card" data-src="data:image/jpeg;base64," data-title="Pièces Or Suisses — 20 Francs">
      <div class="card-img-wrap">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Pièces or suisses 20 Francs" loading="lazy">
      </div>
      <div class="card-caption">
        <h3>Collection</h3>
        <p>20 Francs Suisses — Lot de pièces or</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="gallery-card" data-src="data:image/jpeg;base64," data-title="Plaques Émaillées Publicitaires">
      <div class="card-img-wrap">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Plaques émaillées publicitaires" loading="lazy">
      </div>
      <div class="card-caption">
        <h3>Plaques Émaillées</h3>
        <p>Collection de plaques publicitaires anciennes</p>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>
</section>

<div class="quote-divider">
  <div class="quote-line"></div>
  <p class="quote-text">« L'or a traversé les siècles — chaque pièce raconte une histoire. »</p>
  <div class="quote-line"></div>
</div>

<footer>
  &copy; 2026 Noir-Blanc Numismatique &nbsp;&middot;&nbsp; numismatique@noir-blanc.fr
</footer>

<div id="lightbox">
  <button id="lb-close">&times;</button>
  <img id="lb-img" src="" alt="">
  <div id="lb-cap"></div>
</div>

<script>
// Scroll reveal
const obs = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
  entries.forEach(e => { if(e.isIntersecting){ e.target.classList.add('visible'); obs.unobserve(e.target); } });
}, {threshold:.1});
document.querySelectorAll('.gallery-card').forEach(c => obs.observe(c));

// Lightbox
const lb = document.getElementById('lightbox');
const lbImg = document.getElementById('lb-img');
const lbCap = document.getElementById('lb-cap');
document.querySelectorAll('.gallery-card').forEach(card => {
  card.addEventListener('click', () => {
    lbImg.src = card.dataset.src;
    lbCap.textContent = card.dataset.title || '';
    lb.classList.add('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  });
});
function closeLb() { lb.classList.remove('open'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; }
document.getElementById('lb-close').addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); closeLb(); });
lb.addEventListener('click', e => { if(e.target === lb) closeLb(); });
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if(e.key==='Escape') closeLb(); });

// Email copy
const el = document.getElementById('email');
const tip = document.getElementById('tip');
el.addEventListener('click', () => {
  navigator.clipboard.writeText('numismatique@noir-blanc.fr').catch(() => {
    const s=window.getSelection(),r=document.createRange();
    r.selectNodeContents(el);s.removeAllRanges();s.addRange(r);
    document.execCommand('copy');s.removeAllRanges();
  });
  tip.textContent = '✓ Adresse copiée !';
  tip.classList.add('ok');
  setTimeout(() => { tip.textContent = 'Cliquer pour copier l\'adresse'; tip.classList.remove('ok'); }, 2200);
});
</script>
